head: mean
childOnlyObjective: Ordinary five-rater soft-label NLL fitted only on inner-fit rows aged 6–12; feature moments fitted only on those clips
balancedAllAgeObjective: All-age inner-fit five-rater soft-label NLL multiplied by one global inverse-square-root fit-rater-prevalence class vector; no per-row target renormalization
classWeightCap: Clip maximum/minimum weight ratio to 10, then normalize so the fit-prevalence-weighted mean is 1
missingGlobalFitClass: Reject weighted trials when any global fit class has zero observed ratings; do not add training pseudocounts or synthesize negatives
predictionCorrection: Subtract log(fit class weights) from logits before every unweighted prediction, validation metric and replay; this objective correction is not a finite-model calibration guarantee
selection: Use only ages 6–12 inner-validation macro-phone unweighted per-rater NLL to select epochs; exact ties keep earlier epoch; compare declared learning rates on that same metric
selectionTargetScope: Equal weight to each eligible phone present among child validation rows; record exact phones, speaker/class support and targets absent from fit
priorComparator: Per-phone +1/class prior fitted on exactly the same regime/fold fit rows; preserve observed counts separately and score the same validation rows and child selection slice
reporting: Save best/last checkpoints, corrected probabilities, all-age and child/older proper scores, per-target support, weighted-rater discrimination, fit prevalence/weights/correction and same-fit prior comparison; keep undefined discrimination cells visible
outerEvaluation: Not included in these inner-only trials; no outer metric selects settings
